evals.prompt: Process vehicle ripple data from E:\Vehicle_Date\V0001\V0001_RIPPLE and verify ALL 7 columns from statistics.xlsx are output to Excel: 数据名称, 整段时域有效值, 时域纹波Vpp值, 峰值排序, 频域最大峰值频率, 频域最大峰值, 频域均方根值. Ensure no data is lost.
evals.expected_output: Excel report with all 7 data columns preserved: Time Effective Value, Time VPP, Peak Ranking, Freq Peak, Freq Amplitude, Freq RMS

assertions.name: all_columns_present
assertions.description: All 7 statistics columns should be in Excel output
assertions.check: excel.columns contain ['Time Effective Value', 'Time VPP', 'Peak Ranking', 'Freq Peak (kHz)', 'Freq Peak Amplitude', 'Freq RMS']

assertions.name: no_data_loss
assertions.description: No data rows should be lost

assertions.name: values_match_input

assertions.check: excel.Time VPP matches statistics.时域纹波Vpp值
